note_en: The preposition 对 marks who a feeling or attitude is directed at, and it comes before the adjective or verb: 对丫鬟下人也很和气 "kind even to the maids and servants," 对黛玉多了一分特别的感情 "felt something special for Daiyu." English puts "to" or "for" after the adjective; Chinese puts the 对 phrase first, then the description.
